description: The Mackenzie Panel Back Crib offers a beautiful alternative to the slat design, featuring a solid raised panel headboard that adds warmth and a cozy feel to your nursery. This 4-in-1 convertible crib is crafted from solid hardwood in a rich Brown Maple finish and transitions from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed as your child grows. Three adjustable mattress height settings provide flexibility and safety from newborn to toddler. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials that exceed CPSC and ASTM safety standards. Perfect for pairing with the slat back crib in a shared space or mixing and matching with the complete Mackenzie collection.
